name: schedule_job_audit
label: Scheduled Job Log Table
description: The scheduled job log table is used for tracking the state of related frameworks and for querying related associations in report scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: job_uuid
fields.description: Retrieve the UUID of the schedule_job. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: end_time
fields.description: End time. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Success: success; error: error; processing: processing.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_end_time
indexes.description: Standard index covering the end_time field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_job_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the job_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
